text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall for sustained p99 latency spike on /v1/stream generate (hosted-prod). Detected at 2026-03-15T02:34Z. Current model: redwood-int8-v2. Auto-alert threshold: p99 > 1200ms for 5m.

Maya (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing top-line metrics, tagging SRE.

Olivia: any customer-impact flags yet? which regions?

Mike: quick numbers from observability: p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1600ms streaming tokens. Error rate stable. Spike started ~02:28Z, correlates with a calibration rollout batch at 02:20Z for redwood-int8-v2 in us-west-2.

Nate (ops): logs show KV cache misses increased and tails blocking on dequant step. snippet:
```
[02:29:12] serving: dequant_loop stalled for shard-12, kv_cache_miss_ratio=0.78
[02:29:13] runtime: enqueue_delay=320ms, quant_calib_lightfail=true
[02:29:15] rpc: stream write paused, client_rtt=98ms
```

Luis (quant): looks like the new int8 calibration produced a regression for longer contexts -> more dequant ops hitting slow path. we've seen similar with certain attention kernel fallbacks.

Maya (oncall): initial mitigation options: 1) rollback calibration for redwood-int8-v2 2) enable per-route fallback to redwood-fp16-v1 for streaming 3) add a temporary weight-based routing to dedicated pools. preferences?

Olivia: prioritize customer experience. fallback to fp16 + rollback calibration as follow-up. rollback if fallback not stabilizing.

Mike: I can flip per-route fallback now. command I used:
```
rctl route update --route "/v1/stream" --fallback-model redwood-fp16-v1 --timeout 10s
```
Applying... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: route update accepted, change id: rchg_20260315_01. Will take ~30s to propagate.

Maya (oncall): enabling fallback. pushing monitor alert to reduce noise.

(1m later)
Mike: after fallback p95 ~ 260ms, p99 ~ 520ms, tail improved but still above target. streaming stalls rate dropped ~60%.

Luis (quant): good sign. the fp16 path avoids the dequant fallback. still recommend rolling the calibration back while we investigate why the int8 profile regressed for long sequences.

Nate (ops): preparing rollback command, will coordinate canary and then global. rollback command:
```
rctl model rollback --model redwood-int8-v2 --to-tag stable-2026-03-14 --scope global --force-confirm
```
Scheduling canary now.

Maya (oncall): start canary to 1% traffic, watch p99 for 2m before expanding. keep CS in loop.

Jamie (CS): tagging support. I'll reach out to the 3 customers that reported latencies via support tickets just now and let them know we have an active mitigation and ETA ~15-30m for full stabilization.

(5m later)
Mike: canary rollback looks clean: canary p99 ~ 210ms, no errors. expanding to 20%...

Nate (ops): expanded to 20%. metrics look steady. proceeding to full rollback.

deploy-bot: model rollback completed: rollback_id rb_20260315_07. All regions rolled.

Maya (oncall): full rollback done. monitoring shows p99 back to ~230-500ms depending on burst. closing immediate paging.

Olivia: good. next steps for postmortem? we need root cause, why calibration drifted, and a safer rollout plan (gradual canary + synthetic long-context checks). also add QA evals for long-context tail and KV cache compaction testing.

Luis (quant): adding: the calibration harness didn't include the latest extended-concat evaluation set. that'll be first item. will run a calibration diff locally and post artifacts.

Nate (ops): will add an automated guard: if dequant fallback rate > 20% within 10m of a calibration rollout, auto-halt rollout.

Mike: logging action items to incident tracker. severity: S2 (customer-visible latency but no errors). affected endpoints list, rollback id, route change id, and CS contacts attached.

Jamie (CS): informed customers, queued proactive notes for enterprise accounts. one customer requested a postmortem; we'll coordinate.

Maya (oncall): handing off to Nate for follow-up and RCA checklists. I'm stepping off in 10m.

Nate (ops): I'll own the RCA, follow-ups, and patch for rollout guard. assigning action items and ETA:
- quant: Luis to run calibration diff + fix (ETA 24h)
- infra: Nate to implement auto-halt guard (ETA 48h)
- devex: Mike to add long-context synthetic tests to rollout pipeline (ETA 72h)
- CS: Jamie to prepare customer-facing summary (ETA 6h)

Olivia: thanks team. nice quick mitigation. please attach logs, graphs, and the rollback diff to the incident doc.

Maya (oncall): :white_check_mark: marking as handed off, will monitor slack thread for 30m then unpin.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 2026-03-15T03:02Z. Duration: ~28m. Incident id: inc_20260315_0912.

Nate (ops): adding final note: follow-up RCA will look at calibration dataset drift and runtime kernel selection thresholds for dequant fallbacks. will post RCA draft by EOD tomorrow.

Jamie (CS): closing loop with customers once RCA draft ready.

(End of thread)
